Капитан Гаррет молча протягивает Алану р: Captain Garret silently hands Alan the knight's shield of Prontera: “You've learned to fall back. Now — forward.”
Рыцарь Пронтеры в тяжёлом доспехе. Брава: A Prontera knight in heavy armor. Alan's bravado hasn't shrunk, but now he knows when to step back — and that's why the enemy can't flank the line. Garret keeps him on the right flank and argues no more.
Алан удерживает фланг и выводит раненых,: Alan holds the flank and pulls the wounded out without breaking formation. He takes Lord Knight training as a duty; Garret's personal recognition is still ahead.
Лорд-рыцарь, который всё ещё хочет быть: A Lord Knight who still wants to be first, but counts who came back before anything else. Alan drills a retreat with two wounded and holds the flank while the rest regroup. He passes on Garret's lesson as an order, not bravado; his dream of Prontera's shield still has to be earned by deeds.
Орден Креста принимает Алана: щит теперь: The Order of the Cross accepts Alan: now his shield covers more than just himself.
Крестоносец, давший обет щита. Алан по-п: A Crusader sworn to the shield. Alan still stands up first, but no longer for glory: the order's holy power redirects to him the blows meant for his comrades. When Captain Garret heard, he only snorted: “Still hasn't learned to fall back.”
Алан учится удерживать обет под нескольк: Alan learns to keep his vow under a flurry of blows and hand cover over to the next in line. A Paladin's shield takes not just strength, but knowing your own limits.
Паладин, принимающий чужой удар без обещ: A Paladin who takes the blow meant for another without promising to be invulnerable. Alan measures his vow against whoever stands beside him and learns to call for relief before he falls. The bravado is still in his voice, but his heavy shield now serves people, not a dream of impressing the neighbors.
Мечник из деревни у Пронтеры. Щит, брава: A Swordman from a village near Prontera. A shield, bravado and a habit of standing up first.
Хочет в рыцари Пронтеры, а капитан Гарре: Wants to be a Prontera knight, but Captain Garret won't take him — “not until you learn to fall back.”
Я первым пришёл? Нет? Ладно. Тогда первы: Was I here first? No? Fine. Then I'll be first to stand when they call!
Алан впервые ждёт команды, прежде чем вс: For the first time, Alan waits for the order before standing up. Waits a whole second. Bran writes it down in his notebook as an event.
Алан больше не бежит первым. Он встаёт п: Alan no longer runs in first. He stands first — where there's someone to stand behind him.
Новички в лагере спорят, кто встанет за: Rookies in camp argue over who gets to stand behind Alan. Alan pretends not to hear. He hears.
Гаррет перестаёт оглядываться на Алана в: Garret stops glancing back at Alan in battle. No need: he stands exactly where he should.
Гильдия охотников Хьюджела принимает Бра: The Hugel Hunters Guild accepts Bran. First thing he does is get a falcon — and a new debt notebook.
Охотник из Хьюджела с соколом по имени П: A Hunter from Hugel with a falcon named Percent. Bran sets traps as neatly as he keeps his books, and hits one target — surely, from afar and twice. Alan's debt notebook keeps swelling: the falcon eats too.
Бран сводит следы в карту, выбирает даль: Bran pieces tracks together into a map, picks a distant position and brings Percent back by a safe route. A Sniper's precision starts before the shot.
Снайпер с соколом Процентом и тетрадью,: A Sniper with his falcon Percent and a notebook where the number of those who came back can't be rounded. Bran picks targets by their tracks and the cost of a miss, keeps the far watch and checks the way out. He remembers Alan's debts to the last copper; other people's grief is never collateral to him.
Бран впервые поёт при всех. Долги Алана: Bran sings in front of everyone for the first time. Alan's debts are now in verse.
Бард с луком вместо лютни — струну он вс: A Bard with a bow instead of a lute — he still draws the string. Bran's songs quicken the squad's step and throw off the enemy's aim, and every chorus is a list of other people's debts. He's still a skeptic: he sings, but doesn't believe it's art.
Бран держит общий ритм без спешки и слыш: Bran keeps a shared rhythm without rushing and hears where listeners lose the words. He accepts the Minstrel's mastery along with another person's right to stay silent.
Клоун Комодо, который способен удержать: A Minstrel of Comodo who can hold a whole square with a song, yet won't sing for those whose story he doesn't know yet. Bran turns his records into a shared rhythm, leaves hard names room to breathe, and still hides tenderness behind the percentages in the chorus.
Лучник-скептик: бьёт одну цель, но навер: A skeptic Archer: hits one target, but surely.
Ведёт счёт долгов Алана «на потом» — и о: Keeps a tally of Alan's debts “for later” — and one day he'll collect.
Пиво в долг не беру. Чужие долги записыв: I don't take beer on credit. I write down other people's debts. Is Alan here? Then I'll be a while.
Бран заводит новую тетрадь. Старую не вы: Bran starts a new notebook. He doesn't throw out the old one: there are three more pages of Alan in it.
Бран открывает графу «я» и вписывает пер: Bran opens a column titled “Me” and writes the first line. The first in ten years.
Бран закрывает тетрадь на новой странице: Bran closes the notebook on a fresh page: “The squad owes me more than I owe it. For the first time.”
Бран пересчитывает долги Алана и молча с: Bran recounts Alan's debts and silently writes one off. The smallest — so Alan doesn't get used to it.
Гильдия Моррока предлагает Дорну катары: The Morroc guild offers Dorn katars instead of his debt. He agrees — on his own terms.
Ассасин гильдии Моррока с катарами вмест: An Assassin of the Morroc guild, with katars instead of fists. Dorn never learned to hide — he just strikes first, fast and hard. He has one condition: a fair fight, as long as nobody makes him angry.
Дорн связывает работу катаров с прикрыти: Dorn ties his katar work to covering the squad and learns to stop after the first breakthrough. An Assassin Cross's power doesn't excuse him from checking the path.
Ассасин-кросс, который не научился быть: An Assassin Cross who never learned to go unseen and no longer hides behind the courier role. Dorn checks what's inside the crate left behind and times his first strike with Alan. He fights fair, drinks milk, and is learning to tell friends' laughter from guild humiliation.
Долг гильдии Моррока закрыт. Дорн уходит: The Morroc guild debt is paid. Dorn becomes a Rogue — now he chooses whom to serve.
Разбойник на вольных хлебах: долг гильди: A freelance Rogue: the guild debt is paid, and Dorn serves no one under duress anymore. The Morroc bruiser takes the hits, strips the enemy's weapons and lets no one hurt his own. Thieves give his squad a wide berth.
Дорн учится обезоруживать и читать следы: Dorn learns to disarm and read the traces of haste without answering suspicion with his fist. Stalker training lets him leave a person a way out, not just take their sword.
Сталкер, читающий рваный край бумаги луч: A Stalker who reads the torn edge of a page better than anyone's excuses. Dorn takes weapons away, but never humiliates the unarmed for a laugh. His guild flask now carries what he chose himself; neither Morroc's brand nor a signed IOU decides whom he'll stand for.
Бывший громила из Моррока: дерётся честн: A former Morroc bruiser: fights fair, as long as you don't make him angry.
Должник гильдии воров Моррока — откупает: Owes the Morroc thieves' guild — paying it off with honest service.
Молоко. Место у стены. Кто засмеётся — б: Milk. A seat by the wall. Whoever laughs owes me.
Dorn carries a crate and doesn't look inside. For the first time. It's a crate of Vika's bandages — he trusts her.
Дорн стирает с кирпича «Осталось — 4000»: Dorn wipes “Left — 4000” off the brick. He doesn't write a new number. Let the guild guess.
В Морроке про Дорна говорят шёпотом. Дор: In Morroc they speak of Dorn in whispers. Dorn finds out — and orders his milk louder.
Дорн один поднимает ящик, который несли: Dorn lifts alone a crate that took four to carry yesterday. He only asks “where.” What to carry, he now decides himself.
Гильдия кузнецов Эйнброха вручает Грете: The Einbroch Blacksmith Guild hands Greta a master's hammer. She hung her bell on the handle.
Кузнец гильдии Эйнброха. Грета куёт так: A Blacksmith of the Einbroch guild. Greta forges the way she haggles — fast, loud and in her own favor; the master's hammer hits enemies no worse than a frying pan. The bell on the handle rings before every blow.
Грета осваивает точную обработку и прове: Greta masters precise finishing and testing weapons under load. The master's hammer now means answering for what must not break in a comrade's hands.
Мастер-кузнец со звонким молотом и тракт: A Mastersmith with a ringing hammer and a tavern-keeper's grip. Greta checks her own people's weapons before haggling over loot, and can tell a crack that needs binding from old metal that shouldn't be forced into a new voice. She answers for the bell herself; she lets no other hands near it.
Алхимики Альдебарана берут Грету за умен: The Al De Baran alchemists take Greta for her head for numbers. She kept the frying pan.
Алхимик Альдебарана: зелья, склянки и то: An Alchemist of Al De Baran: potions, vials and precise math — a drop for every wounded. Greta heals the squad and keeps a ledger of every flask spent. The frying pan hangs at her belt: in case the recipe doesn't work.
Грета доводит составы до повторяемого ре: Greta refines her mixtures until the results are repeatable and checks how they combine. A Biochemist's right to test new things gives her no right to risk her own people.
Создательница, которая считает каждую ка: A Biochemist who counts every drop but knows how to write “not on credit.” Greta tests a mixture on a sample before trusting it to a comrade, and warns ahead of time about the last vial. The family bell is neither an experiment nor merchandise to her, whatever anyone offers.
Торговка с тяжёлой сковородкой. Считает: A Merchant with a heavy frying pan. Counts coin faster than enemies count blows.
Дочь трактирщика; три часа просидела в ж: The tavern keeper's daughter; spent three hours stuck in Mastering's jelly and came out angry and with a bell.
Отец, я наняла себя сама. Торговалась жё: Father, I hired myself. Drove a hard bargain — only gave up the frying pan.
Грета перевешивает сковородку на другой: Greta moves the frying pan to her other hip. Says it's for balance. Bruno says it's to draw it faster.
Грета вешает над стойкой вывеску: «Грета: Greta hangs a sign over the counter: “Greta. Charges a lot. Works fast.” Bruno sighs and nails it straighter.
Колокольчик звенит у Греты чище прежнего: Greta's bell rings clearer than ever. She says it respects her even more now. Nobody dares to argue.
Грета моет сковородку до боя. Примета пл: Greta washes the frying pan before a fight. Bad omen. For the enemy.
Ирис берёт двуручник рыцаря Пронтеры. Щи: Iris takes up the two-handed sword of a Prontera knight. She still has no need for a shield.
Рыцарь Пронтеры с двуручным мечом и без: A Prontera knight with a two-handed sword and no shield — the order's code doesn't approve, but doesn't forbid it either. Iris cuts through enemy lines with wide swings and is first to break through to the wounded. Her former brothers in the order now speak of her with respect.
Ирис доводит бой двуручником до прикрыти: Iris refines her two-handed fighting until it can cover a retreat with someone on her shoulders. She proves her Lord Knight training with lives saved, not by waiting for forgiveness from her old order.
Лорд-рыцарь с двуручником, которую изгна: A two-handed Lord Knight, exiled for dropping her shield to save three wounded. Iris teaches others to leave carrying the load, not to argue over glory. She takes no money from those she saves; she carries the tags of the fallen to return their names and resting places to their families, not as tokens of her victories.
Орден, изгнавший Ирис, зовёт её обратно: The order that exiled Iris calls her back — now as a shield for everyone.
Крестоносец, вернувшаяся в орден, которы: A Crusader who returned to the order that once exiled her. Iris has taken up a shield again — not for herself, but to cover everyone she once carried out on her shoulders. The order's holy light now serves her own rule: the wounded are never left behind.
Ирис учится держать щит неподвижно под д: Iris learns to hold her shield steady under a long assault. A Paladin's guard is needed where neither the wounded nor their comrade can be ordered to hurry.
Паладин, которая не путает клятву с прик: A Paladin who never confuses an oath with an order to abandon her own. Iris holds the passage while someone else works on their knees, and says a prayer over every tag she finds. Her bond with Garret fits into a nod: both know the weight of a person they managed to carry out.
Мечница с двуручником. Щит считает лишни: A Swordman with a two-handed sword. Considers a shield dead weight.
Изгнана из ордена Пронтеры: бросила щит,: Exiled from the Prontera order: dropped her shield to carry out the wounded.
Щит оставлю у входа. Нет, Бруно, не забы: I'll leave the shield at the door. No, Bruno, I didn't forget it. With someone wounded on your shoulders, a shield only gets in the way.
Ирис учит Алана поднимать раненого на пл: Iris teaches Alan to lift a wounded man onto his shoulders. Alan asks what to do with his shield. Iris just looks at him.
Ирис пересчитывает жетоны на поясе и веш: Iris counts the tags on her belt and hangs them back. They've gotten lighter to carry. Not the tags — her.
Строй за Ирис держится без команды. Она: The line holds behind Iris without a command. She doesn't shout “forward” — she just doesn't leave.
Рыцари ордена встают, когда Ирис входит: The knights of the order rise when Iris walks into the Two Bells. Nobody touches the shield by the door anymore.
Гефенская башня прощает Каю библиотеку:: Geffen Tower forgives Kai for the library: it needs his storms more than its books.
Волшебник Гефенской башни, мастер грозы: A Wizard of Geffen Tower, master of storms and meteors. Kai still burns first, but at least he aims now; the librarians hide their scrolls from him all the same. He's working off the burned library on the battlefield.
Кай усиливает грозу вместе с точным прек: Kai learns to amplify the storm and to end a spell precisely. High Wizard training means checking for himself where the last spark will go.
Верховный маг, который всё ещё любит бол: A High Wizard who still loves a big experiment but has started counting its cost before the flash. Kai drills stopping a storm without Lira and learns to sign others' work with their names. The bucket stays: power must never again become a bill his sister pays.
Академия Юно берёт Кая с условием: жечь: Juno Academy takes Kai on one condition: burn only enemies.
Мудрец Академии Юно: огонь, молнии и нем: A Sage of Juno Academy: fire, lightning and a bit of theory. Kai learns to weave the elements into his allies' spells — and to burn only those who need burning. His sister Lira calls it a miracle; the academy calls it probation.
Кай переводит вспышку в управляемое усил: Kai channels his flare into a controlled boost for others' weapons and writes down the conditions for stopping. Professor training doesn't cancel his Juno probation yet.
Профессор Юно на испытательном сроке, сп: A Juno Professor on probation, able to argue for three hours and still learning a single snowflake from his sister. Kai weaves fire into someone else's sword, records the heat limit and learns to choose precision over spectacle. A report has to hold up to review even when its author isn't around.
Маг огня и молний. Сначала жжёт, потом д: A mage of fire and lightning. Burns first, thinks later.
Спалил библиотеку Гефенской башни и тепе: Burned down the Geffen Tower library and is now working off the debt.
Я только чай согреть! …Ведро? Зачем ведр: I just wanted to warm up some tea! …A bucket? Why a bucket? Fine, let it stand there.
Кай зажигает в таверне свечу. Одну. Свеч: Kai lights a candle in the tavern. Just one. Candle intact, table intact. Lira warily touches the ice in her pocket.
Кай пишет в Гефен письмо о прощении долг: Kai writes to Geffen asking for his debt to be forgiven. The letter burns up on the third line. Kai writes it again.
Гроза Кая бьёт ровно в цель. Лира впервы: Kai's storm strikes dead on target. For the first time, Lira doesn't keep the bucket ready. She does — but behind her back.
Кай гасит свой огонь сам. Лира долго смо: Kai puts out his own fire. Lira looks at him for a long time — then silently hands him her piece of ice.
Лира заканчивает башню Гефена: её лёд те: Lira graduates from Geffen Tower: her ice can now hold back a whole army.
A Wizard of Geffen, mistress of ice. Her ice walls and blizzards stop entire enemy squads while her own regroup. Lira still fixes whatever her brother burned — only now she does it with a storm.
Лира рассчитывает ледяную стену на целый: Lira calculates an ice wall for an entire formation, with a way out for her own. To her, high mastery means holding the defense without locking the squad behind it.
Верховная волшебница, чьи стены оставляю: A High Wizard whose walls leave room for the wounded and for changing the watch. Lira hears a crack before the column falls and speaks quietly, but doesn't ask permission to give an order. She's learning to create her own things, not just fix Kai's; she doesn't pass off caring for her brother as her only calling.
Юно учит Лиру снимать чужие чары. Чинить: Juno teaches Lira to dispel others' magic. Fixing things got easier.
Мудрец Юно, знаток чужих чар. Лира снима: A Sage of Juno, expert in others' enchantments. Lira lifts curses, snuffs out enemy magic and shields the squad with protective signs. Cleaning up after Kai got much easier: now she puts out the fire before it even starts.
Лира проверяет полевые расчёты и запас н: Lira checks the field calculations and the margin for error, including Kai's heat. Professor training means stopping an experiment in time and bringing everyone back up.
Профессор, оставляющая в расчёте запас н: A Professor who leaves a margin in her calculations for one brother. Lira checks observations against people instead of declaring their memories mistaken, and is honest about the limits of her method. Her lists protect the squad; she's only learning to put a personal list next to the work one.
Маг льда и защиты: замедляет врагов и пр: A mage of ice and defense: slows enemies and shields allies.
Kai's sister — fixes everything he burns.
Is Kai here already? Then a table by the door for me. And water. Lots of water.
Lira puts an ice sigil over Kai's table. Kai is offended. The table is intact.
Лира впервые колдует не ради брата. Кай: For the first time, Lira casts a spell not for her brother. Kai sets nothing on fire — just to stay out of the way.
Лёд Лиры держит весь строй. Говорит она: Lira's ice holds the entire line. She still speaks quietly — but now it's not only Kai who hears her.
Лира вычёркивает последнюю строку из спи: Lira crosses the last line off her “fix after Kai” list. She doesn't start a new one.
Лесники Пайона учат Мэйлин ставить капка: The Payon foresters teach Meilin to set traps. The white wolf is somewhere near.
Охотница пайонских лесов: капканы, ловуш: A Huntress of the Payon woods: snares, traps and a falcon that sees farther than she does. Meilin follows the white wolf's trail across all of Midgard and lets no enemy escape along the way. Her father's bow is closer than it seems.
Мэйлин соединяет тихий подход с дальним: Meilin combines a quiet approach with long-range shots and a safe path around the traps. A Sniper's position must let her see not just the target, but her own people too.
Снайпер из Пайона с соколом и отцовским: A Sniper from Payon with a falcon and her father's quiet step. Meilin lays traps for pursuers but leaves her own a marked way around. She seeks the bow carried off by the white wolf, never forgetting: it was guarding the sleepers, not hunting prey. She heads north, leaving a way back.
Мэйлин танцует со стрелами в Комодо — и: Meilin dances among arrows in Comodo — and the enemy loses step.
Танцовщица Комодо, чьи шаги сбивают враг: A Dancer of Comodo whose steps knock the enemy off rhythm. Meilin whirls between arrows and songs, and the enemy line falls apart. She still seeks the white wolf — they say it comes to the sound of her tambourine.
Мэйлин учится смещать шаг, не теряя ритм: Meilin learns to shift her step without losing the rhythm for her comrades. She needs Gypsy training to lead people out of someone else's song, not to hold them in her own.
Цыганка Комодо, превратившая лесной шаг: A Gypsy of Comodo who turned her forest step into a rhythm of return. Meilin keeps the tambourine going until the last scout reaches the fire, and breaks the enemy's beat to let her own slip out. She follows the white wolf without bait: an onlooker deserves a free way back too.
Лучница из Пайона: дождь стрел по всему: An Archer from Payon: a rain of arrows on the entire enemy line.
Дочь пайонского лесничего; ищет белого в: Daughter of a Payon forester; hunts the white wolf that carried off her father's bow.
Деревьев тут нет. Поздороваюсь с балкой: No trees in here. I'll greet the beam — it was a pine once too. Have you seen a white wolf?
У двери «Двух колоколов» Мэйлин находит: At the door of the Two Bells, Meilin finds the white wolf's tracks. Fresh. She never takes the arrow off the string.
Мэйлин вырезает на луке своё имя. Чуть н: Meilin carves her name into her bow. Just below, she leaves room — for her father's.
Птицы в лесу не смолкают, когда идёт Мэй: The birds in the forest don't fall silent when Meilin walks. They fall silent when she draws her bow.
Белый волк выходит на опушку, смотрит на: The white wolf steps out to the forest's edge, looks at Meilin and doesn't leave. Seems it was waiting for her.
Отто выковал новую тележку сам. Эту уже: Otto forged a new cart himself. No manhole will swallow this one.
Кузнец и возчик в одном лице: новую теле: Blacksmith and carter in one: Otto forged his new cart himself, with iron sides. He stands at the front of the squad like a living wall, while the cart serves as battering ram and cover. Sewers and manholes hold no fear anymore — its wheels are steel.
Отто проверяет оси, крепления и железо п: Otto tests axles, fittings and iron under a live load. Masterwork has to survive the road, not just please the buyer on the spot.
Мастер-кузнец и альбертинский возчик, ра: A Mastersmith and Alberta carter who can tell what's wrong with a cart by its creak. Otto remembers his father's hand on the driver's seat, but won't excuse a bad axle with memories. He mends even an orc's club without haggling; to him, the most precious cargo is people who must arrive in one piece.
Отто грузит в тележку кислоту вместо тов: Otto loads his cart with acid instead of goods. Fewer customers now — fewer enemies, too.
Алхимик на колёсах: вместо товара в теле: An Alchemist on wheels: instead of goods, acid sloshes and fire flasks rattle in Otto's cart. He hits enemies from afar with what he'd once have sold at the Alberta market. Trade had to wait — the customers fled.
Отто осваивает точную дозировку и безопа: Otto masters precise dosing and the safe transport of mixtures. Biochemist training means delivering a potion intact and using it where it's truly needed.
Создатель с тележкой, где кислота отделе: A Biochemist with a cart where the acid is kept apart from the healing potions. Otto knows the price of three drops and first shelters what must not spoil. He writes to his mother briefly but regularly; he keeps carting the squad by his own choice, without losing touch with Alberta.
Альбертинский возчик с тележкой — таран: An Alberta carter with a cart — the squad's battering ram and shield.
Его тележку унесло в стоки Пронтеры; хоч: His cart got swept into the Prontera sewers; he wants it back, even one wheel at a time.
Колесо не продам. Два — продам. Тележку: I won't sell a wheel. Two — I'll sell. Don't touch the cart: it's nervous.
Отто находит в стоках ещё одно колесо. С: Otto finds another wheel in the sewers. His own. He kisses it — and immediately offers to sell it to Greta.
Отто прибивает к тележке табличку «Не пр: Otto nails a “Not for sale” sign to his cart. Then adds below in small print: “Expensive.”
Орк бьёт Отто дубиной. Отто скрипит. Орк: An orc hits Otto with a club. Otto creaks. The orc looks at his club. The club is splinters.
Отто ставит тележку поперёк моста. Мост: Otto parks his cart across the bridge. The bridge holds, the cart holds. Otto writes the enemy a parking ticket.
Хор, выгнавший Тео, слушает его проповед: The choir that kicked Teo out comes to hear him preach. The volume came in handy.
Жрец, чей голос слышно через всё поле бо: A Priest whose voice carries across the whole battlefield. Teo blesses the squad, banishes the undead and, at last, heals for real. The choir that kicked him out for being too loud now comes to hear his sermons.
Тео удерживает благословение и голос на: Teo keeps up his blessing and his voice through a long service to the very last words. The rank of High Priest means answering not just for the volume, but for those listening.
Верховный жрец с голосом, которому собор: A High Priest with a voice the cathedral once proved too small for. Teo learns not to hide his trumpet, but to put it where it's needed and save his breath for the last line. He can raise a whole square with a prayer; afterwards he'll explain to the guards himself why it wasn't an alarm.
Тео даёт обет молчания и сразу его наруш: Teo takes a vow of silence and breaks it at once — with a battle cry.
Монах святой Капитолины с кулаками тяжел: A Monk of Saint Capitolina with fists heavier than a prayer book. Teo strikes in combos and knocks enemies down with his battle cry; his vow of silence lasted exactly until the first brawl. The abbot gave up and issued him knuckles.
Тео соединяет дыхание, паузу и удар духа: Teo unites breath, pause and spirit strike without wasting strength on a second shout. Champion training starts with being able to hear a comrade.
Чемпион святой Капитолины, собравший сво: A Champion of Saint Capitolina who has gathered his trumpet into a single precise cry. Teo can whisper an order through the din and leave others room in the silence. He still rejoices loud enough for the whole block, but saves his strength to open a path for his own, not to prove he can be heard.
Боевой послушник: свет и благословения,: A battle novice: light and blessings, not much healing.
Выгнали из хора за громкость — теперь ег: Kicked out of the choir for being too loud — now enemies hear his voice.
ЗДРАВСТВУЙТЕ! Это я шёпотом. Бруно, не н: HELLO! That was me whispering. Bruno, don't — the mugs fell on their own.
Тео поёт утреннюю молитву вполголоса. На: Teo sings the morning prayer under his breath. Pigeons take off all over Prontera. All of them.
Регент хора присылает Тео записку из одн: The choirmaster sends Teo a one-word note: “Louder.” Teo cries. Loudly, too.
Тео шепчет благословение. Его слышит вес: Teo whispers a blessing. The whole line hears it — and half the enemy's.
Тео замолкает посреди боя. Враги замираю: Teo goes quiet in the middle of a battle. The enemies freeze: they fear that silence more than any shout.
Собор Пронтеры посвящает Вику в жрицы. Р: The Prontera Cathedral ordains Vika a Priestess. Her hands no longer shake when someone's wounded nearby.
Жрица собора Пронтеры. Вика всё ещё боит: A Priestess of the Prontera Cathedral. Vika is still afraid of blood, but her hands no longer shake: her healing keeps the whole squad on its feet. She still carries bandages — just in case.
Вика сохраняет защиту нескольких раненых: Vika keeps several wounded protected and saves strength for the next dressing. The rank of High Priestess doesn't cancel fear; it demands she not abandon the work.
Верховная жрица с приютским стежком и би: A High Priestess with an orphanage stitch and bandages at hand. Vika is still afraid of blood, but spreads her healing so there's enough for the last wounded. She doesn't promise to undo every loss, and she's learning to accept Greta's care, not just give her own.
Вика уходит в монастырь святой Капитолин: Vika joins the Saint Capitolina monastery: now she shields the wounded herself.
Монахиня святой Капитолины: раненых она: A Monk of Saint Capitolina: now she covers the wounded with her own body, not just bandages them. Vika takes the blows and answers with a palm strike trained in the monastery. Blood still scares her, but stepping aside scares her more.
Вика удерживает защитную стойку и выбира: Vika holds a defensive stance and picks her moment to strike back without exposing the wounded. She masters a Champion's power along with the right not to land an extra blow.
Чемпионка святой Капитолины, чья открыта: A Champion of Saint Capitolina whose open palm shields the wounded first of all. Vika keeps her breath steady under blows and never spends a counter on revenge. Letters to her missing guardian lie under the bandages; silence keeps her pain, but doesn't stop her from hearing a call for help.
Аколит из церкви Пронтеры. «Бинты со мно: An Acolyte from the Prontera church. “I've got bandages.”
Сирота, боится крови, но не бросает ране: An orphan, afraid of blood, but never abandons the wounded.
I've got bandages. Blood… I'm not afraid. Almost. Who needs patching up?
Вика перевязывает Алана одной рукой, дру: Vika bandages Alan with one hand and holds a cup in the other. Her hands barely shake. The tea does.
Вика вяжет бинт узлом, которому учил оте: Vika ties a bandage with the knot Father Benedict taught her. Then unties it — and ties her own. Tighter.
Вика больше не считает бинты. Их всегда: Vika no longer counts bandages. There are always enough — now she knows where to look.
Over the wounded, Vika speaks quietly and firmly. The wounded stops being afraid. So does Vika.
Зара возвращается в Моррок ассасином. То: Zara returns to Morroc as an Assassin. The one who framed her already knows.
A Morroc Assassin with poison on every blade. Zara has returned to where she was framed, and the traitor's name is nearly in her hands. Enemies fall before they notice her shadow.
Зара доводит скрытый подход и работу кат: Zara hones her stealthy approach and katar work into a clean exit with no innocent casualties. An Assassin Cross's power doesn't make every servant of Set her debtor.
Ассасин-кросс Моррока, которая оставляет: A Morroc Assassin Cross who leaves Set sand under his door but won't touch the guards for revenge. Zara checks her escape routes and carries the antidote before the poison. She still greets Dorn with a knife-shaped question; she knows Bruno trusts her by the coffee she no longer checks.
Зара учится отнимать у врага оружие и до: Zara learns to take the enemy's weapon and armor, not just their purse.
Разбойница с большой дороги у Комодо: сн: A highway Rogue from near Comodo: she strips the enemy of weapon and armor, and their fighting spirit along with them. Zara chooses cunning over revenge — for now. Whoever framed her in Morroc will hear from her yet.
Зара осваивает обезоруживание и сохранен: Zara masters disarming and preserving evidence for verification. Stalker training lets her leave without a sound; she chooses not to leave someone else's guilt behind her.
Сталкер, способная снять ремень незаметн: A Stalker who can lift a belt unnoticed and return it with a better buckle. Zara guards evidence as carefully as her antidote and pays for her own decisions. More than revenge on Set, she fears becoming him: walking away clean, leaving an innocent in her place.
Воровка с ядовитыми ножами из пустыни Со: A Thief with poisoned knives from the Sograt Desert.
Hunts the one who framed her in Morroc.
Нож у горла — не угроза, трактирщик. Это: A knife at your throat isn't a threat, barkeep. It's a question: where's your back door?
Зара убирает нож от горла Брана на полсе: Zara takes her knife from Bran's throat half a second sooner than usual. Bran notes it down: progress.
Зара отправляет в Моррок письмо без подп: Zara sends an unsigned letter to Morroc. Inside — a single knife. The recipient will understand.
Дорн впервые видит, как Зара смеётся. За: Dorn sees Zara laugh for the first time. Zara doesn't like that he saw. Dorn keeps quiet — he'd like to live.
Сет не спит третью ночь: под дверью кажд: Set hasn't slept for three nights: every morning there's Sograt sand under his door. Zara sleeps just fine.
